# Sri Prakash Car Travels - Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh

> Sri Prakash Car Travels is Kakinada's premier 24/7 taxi and cab service provider with 15+ years of experience, operating our own verified fleet of sedans, SUVs, tempo travellers, and luxury coaches.

## Services
- Local City Taxi Service in Kakinada
- Airport Taxi: Rajahmundry (RJA), Vizag (VTZ), Vijayawada (VGA), Hyderabad (HYD)
- Outstation Cabs: One Way & Round Trip
- Temple Tour Packages: Annavaram, Draksharamam, Pancharamalu, Pithapuram, Tirupati
- Holiday Packages: Araku Valley, Lambasingi, Maredumilli, Papikondalu, Konaseema
- Corporate Travel & Wedding Car Booking
- Daily & Monthly Cab Rentals
- Tempo Traveller & Luxury Bus Hire (12-45 seater)
